item.title: The oracle given to Alkmedes #6152 came to nothing: "When the boneless one climbs the mast
item.description: The oracle given to Alkmedes #6152 came to nothing: "When the boneless one climbs the mast, look to your own house." Or it came true in some way nobody has noticed yet. Phaiddotos #8798 is not consulted as often.

item.title: Demkrates #8423 has made a blame-song about Alkmedes #6152, iambic and filthy, and the who
item.description: Demkrates #8423 has made a blame-song about Alkmedes #6152, iambic and filthy, and the whole Agora is singing it. Alkmedes #6152 has not been seen in public since.
